PostpartumRecovery.6: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe: ibisanzwe nyuma yo kubyara.
PostpartumRecovery.8: Gusobanukirwa igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara
PostpartumRecovery.9: Iminsi ya mbere: kugenda gake no gukira
PostpartumRecovery.10: Ibishobora kuba bisanzwe mu gihe cyo gukira
PostpartumRecovery.12: Kugenda no gusubukura ibikorwa buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.18: Gusobanukirwa igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara
PostpartumRecovery.19: Iminsi ya mbere: kugenda gake no gukira
PostpartumRecovery.20: Ibishobora kuba bisanzwe mu gihe cyo gukira
PostpartumRecovery.22: Kugenda no gusubukura ibikorwa buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.28: Igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara gikurikira kubyara. Ntigigarukira ku minsi mike: umubiri, imigendekere ya buri munsi n’amarangamutima bishobora gukomeza guhinduka buhoro buhoro mu byumweru bikurikiraho.
PostpartumRecovery.29: “Quarantaine” ni ijambo gakondo rikunze gukoreshwa mu kuvuga ibyumweru bya mbere byo gukira. Rishobora kuba urwibutso rwiza: nyuma yo gutwita no kubyara, ni byiza kugenda gake no guha umubiri igihe.
PostpartumRecovery.31: Gukira bireba umubiri, ariko kandi no gusinzira, imbaraga, imigendekere ya buri munsi no kumenyera icyiciro gishya cy’ubuzima mu mutima.
PostpartumRecovery.32: Iminsi ya mbere ishobora kuba ikomeye. Kuruhuka, kwitabwaho by’ibanze no kumenyera uburyo bushya akenshi ni byo by’ingenzi. Nta mpamvu yo gusubirana ako kanya imbaraga zawe zisanzwe.
PostpartumRecovery.34: Guhinduranya gukora no kuruhuka bifasha umubiri gukira buhoro buhoro.
PostpartumRecovery.36: Kurya buri gihe no kunywa bijyanye n’ibyo ukeneye bifasha gukira buri munsi.
PostpartumRecovery.38: Kwemera ubufasha bituma ubika imbaraga ku byo kwitaho by’ingenzi no gukira.
PostpartumRecovery.40: Subukura buhoro buhoro ingendo n’ibikorwa, wubaha uko umeze n’uko wiyumva.
PostpartumRecovery.41: Gukira kwa buri wese kuratandukanye. Impinduka zimwe zishobora kuba ari igice cyo kumenyera kandi zigahinduka buhoro buhoro:
PostpartumRecovery.43: Kuva amaraso agenda agabanuka buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.45: Ubukana n’igihe bimara by’ibimenyetso bishobora gutandukana ku muntu ku wundi. Icy’ingenzi ni ukureba uko bihinduka no gusaba inama niba impinduka igutera impungenge cyangwa ari idasanzwe.
PostpartumRecovery.46: Mu gihe cya nyuma yo kubyara, imigenzo mito kandi ishoboka akenshi ifasha kurusha gahunda iruhije. Intego ni ugufasha gukira utongeyeho igitutu.
PostpartumRecovery.47: Tegura ibihe nyabyo byo kuruhuka igihe cyose bishoboka.
PostpartumRecovery.48: Saba ubufasha mu mirimo ya buri munsi no mu biryo.
PostpartumRecovery.49: Nywa buri gihe kandi urye indyo itandukanye.
PostpartumRecovery.51: Subukura ibikorwa buhoro buhoro, utagerageza gukora byose ako kanya.
PostpartumRecovery.53: Kwishyira hamwe n’abagufasha no kwemera ubufasha si iby’ubuhenzi. Bishobora gufasha kubika imbaraga no gutuma gukira kugenda buhoro buhoro.
PostpartumRecovery.54: Gusubukura ibikorwa bishobora gukorwa intambwe ku yindi, bitewe n’uko wiyumva, imbaraga n’inama wahawe nyuma yo kubyara. Ingendo zoroheje n’ibikorwa bya buri munsi biranabarwa nko gusubira mu kugenda.
PostpartumRecovery.55: Ku bikorwa bikomeye cyane, ni byiza gutera imbere utasimbuye intambwe kandi wita ku bimenyetso cyangwa kutamererwa neza kwose.
PostpartumRecovery.57: Kutamererwa neza kwiyongera mu gihe cy’igikorwa ni impamvu yo kugabanya umuvuduko no, igihe bibaye ngombwa, gusaba inama zikubereye mbere yo gukomeza cyangwa kongera ubukana.
PostpartumRecovery.58: Gusinzira bishobora kuba bidahoraho nyuma yo kubyara. Kunanirwa kwegeranye bishobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga, ku kwita ku kintu no ku mitekerereze. Igihe bishoboka, koroshya imirimo imwe n’imwe no gusangira inshingano bishobora gufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.62: Gukira buhoro buhoro no gutangira imigenzo mishya.
PostpartumRecovery.63: Nyuma y’isuzuma ryo nyuma yo kubyara
PostpartumRecovery.64: Suzuma uko gukira kugenda kandi muganire ku gusubukura ibikorwa buhoro buhoro.
PostpartumRecovery.65: Igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara gishobora kuzana amarangamutima menshi: ibyishimo, impungenge, kunanirwa, kumva cyane, cyangwa kumva urenzwe. Ibi byiyumvo bishobora guhinduka vuba, cyane cyane mu gihe cyo gusinzira n’imigenzo ya buri munsi bihinduka.
PostpartumRecovery.66: Kuvugana n’umuntu wizeye cyangwa n’umuhanga bishobora gufasha iyo amarangamutima ashobora kugorana kuyagenzura cyangwa afata umwanya munini mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
PostpartumRecovery.68: Nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ko unanirwa burundu cyangwa ko urenzwe kugira ngo uvuge uko wiyumva kandi usabe ubufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.69: Zimwe mu ngorane zikwiye kuganirwaho n’umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima, cyane cyane iyo ziyongera, zikomeza, cyangwa zitera impungenge zikomeye.
PostpartumRecovery.71: Ububabare cyangwa kutamererwa neza byiyongera aho kugabanuka bikwiye inama z’umuhanga.
PostpartumRecovery.73: Kuva amaraso yiyongera gitunguranye cyangwa adasanzwe bikwiye kumenyeshwa umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.
PostpartumRecovery.75: Niba agahinda ko mu mutima gafata umwanya munini cyangwa gatuma ubuzima bwa buri munsi bugorana, ni ngombwa kukavuga no gusaba ubufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.77: Niba ufite gushidikanya ku gukira kwawe, gusaba inama bigufasha kubona ibyifuzo bikwiranye n’uko umeze.
PostpartumRecovery.78: Gahunda zo gukurikirana ni amahirwe yo kuganira ku gukira, ku bimenyetso, ku gusubukura ibikorwa no ku bibazo bisigaye. Gutegura ibibazo bike mbere bishobora gufasha kwemeza ko nta kintu cyibagirana.
PostpartumRecovery.80: Ese gukira kwanjye kurimo kugenda nk’uko byitezwe ku buryo meze?
PostpartumRecovery.81: Ni ibihe bikorwa nshobora gusubukura buhoro buhoro?
PostpartumRecovery.83: Ni ryari nshobora gutekereza gusubira mu myitozo ikomeye kurushaho?
PostpartumRecovery.84: Ese nkeneye inama zihariye cyangwa imyitozo yo gukira?
PostpartumRecovery.85: Gukira nyuma yo kubyara kugenda buhoro buhoro kandi kuratandukanye kuri buri wese.
PostpartumRecovery.86: Kuruhuka n’ubufasha bishobora kuba igice cy’ingenzi cyo gukira.
PostpartumRecovery.87: Impinduka z’umubiri, gusinzira n’amarangamutima bishobora guhinduka mu byumweru.
PostpartumRecovery.88: Gusubukura ibikorwa buhoro buhoro bigufasha kubaha neza imbaraga zawe n’uko wiyumva.
PostpartumRecovery.89: Niba ubonye ikimenyetso kidasanzwe, gikomeza cyangwa kigutera impungenge, gusaba inama ni intambwe nziza.
PostpartumRecovery.91: Gukira si isiganwa. Kujya imbere buhoro buhoro, wubaha ibyo ukeneye kandi usaba ubufasha igihe bibaye ngombwa ni intambwe z’ingenzi.
PostpartumRecovery.92: Iyi nkuru ni iy’amakuru gusa kandi ntisimbura inama za muganga zihariye. Niba ufite ikimenyetso gikomeye, gikomeza cyangwa kigutera impungenge, vugana n’umuganga ushinzwe ubuzima.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Impamvu isengesho ry’imihango rihagarikwa muri iki gihe, n’uburyo bwo kubaho muri iki gihe wicecekeye mu mutima.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by’idini bigomba kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa ibyemezo by’idini byihariye.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Nta kwishyura amasengesho yasibwe, bitandukanye no gusiba
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Mu gihe cy’imihango, inshingano y’isengesho (salat) irahagarikwa: umugore ntategekwa gusenga muri iki gihe. Uku guhagarikwa ni igice cy’imigenzo y’idini ubwayo, cyemewe kuva kera n’umuco.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Uku guhagarikwa ntibisobanura kure y’ukwemera cyangwa kureka imigenzo y’idini. Ni ihari ryemewe, ryo kubaho nta kwicira urubanza: ni igice cy’urwego rusanzwe rw’ubuzima bwo mu mwuka bw’umugore.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Iki gihe gishobora kubonwa mu gicecekere cy’umutima: nta ho gihuriye no gushidikanya ku gaciro k’ukwemera cyangwa ku buryo imigenzo y’idini ikorwa.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Niba imihango itangiye mu gihe cy’isengesho, riragabanywa: ntirikeneye gusozwa cyangwa kwishyurwa. Ku rundi ruhande, imihango irangiye, isengesho risubukurwa nk’uko bisanzwe nyuma ya ghusl (kwiyuhagira kw’ingenzi), kwerekana gusubira mu isuku y’imigenzo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: Bitandukanye no gusiba Ramadan, iminsi yasibwe mu gihe cy’imihango yishyurwa nyuma (qadaa), amasengesho yasibwe kubera iyo mpamvu ubwayo ntiyishyurwa nyuma muri rusange. Itandukaniro risobanurwa n’imiterere y’ibi bikorwa byombi byo gusenga: isengesho ni igikorwa cya buri munsi gisubirwamo inshuro nyinshi ku munsi, naho gusiba ni umwaka kandi bigashyirwa ku kwezi kumwe kwihariye.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Iri tandukaniro rishobora gutangaza igihe umuntu atangiye kumenya fiqh. Ntibivuze ko isengesho rifite agaciro gake: gukurikiza ihari uko ryategetswe, ubwayo, ni igice cyuzuye cy’imigenzo y’idini.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Kudasenga mu gihe cy’imihango ntibivuze gutandukana n’ubuzima bwo mu mwuka. Uburyo bwinshi bwo gusenga no kwiyemeza mu idini buracyashoboka muri iki gihe.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Imigenzo imwe, nko gusoma cyangwa gukora ku buryo bweruye Quran, ishobora kugira ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko y’idini. Gusubira ku gitekerezo ukunze gukurikiza, cyangwa gusaba inama umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi, bifasha gusobanura ibi bihe.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Isengesho rihagarikwa mu gihe cy’imihango ni ihari ryemewe, ryo kubaho nta kwicira urubanza. Uburyo bwinshi bwo mu mwuka buracyashoboka muri iki gihe, kandi inama z’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi zikomeza kuba isoko ku kibazo cyihariye cyose.

PregnancyExercise.1:
Gukomeza gukora imyitozo
mu gihe cyo gutwita
PregnancyExercise.6: Gukomeza gukora byoroheje, mu mutekano, muri buri trimestre.
PregnancyExercise.13: Kugenda, koga na yoga y’abatwite bisanzwe byemerwa mu gihe cyose cyo gutwita, mu muvuduko ujyanye n’uko wiyumva.
PregnancyExercise.17: Irinde siporo ikomeye cyangwa ibikorwa bifite ibyago byo kugwa, cyane cyane uhereye kuri trimestre ya kabiri:
PregnancyExercise.18: Siporo zikomeye (kwiruka cyane, siporo z’ibikoresho zigendera ku muvuduko mwinshi)
PregnancyExercise.19: Ibikorwa bifite ibyago byo kugwa (gusiga ku rubura, kugendera ku mafarasi, gutwara igare ahantu habi)
PregnancyExercise.20: Siporo zo kurwana cyangwa zo guhura
PregnancyExercise.21: Imbaraga nyinshi ahantu hirengeye cyangwa mu bushyuhe bukabije
PregnancyExercise.23: Ububabare, kuva amaraso, cyangwa gukanda kwa nyababyeyi mu gihe cy’imyitozo
PregnancyExercise.25: Buri gihe umva ibimenyetso by’umubiri wawe kandi uvugane n’umubyaza cyangwa muganga mbere yo gutangira cyangwa guhindura igikorwa cy’umubiri.
PregnancyExercise.27: Imyitozo yoroheje kandi ikorwa buri gihe ifitiye akamaro gutwita kwinshi: ikibazo ni uguhuza ubukana n’icyiciro cyose n’uko wiyumva.
PregnancyExercise.28: Gukomeza gukora imyitozo mu gihe cyo gutwita — AWA

PregnancyWeekly.6: Ibihe by’ingenzi kuva kuri trimestre ya mbere kugeza ku ya gatatu, kugira ngo umenye ibyo witeze muri buri cyiciro.
PregnancyWeekly.7: Buri gutwita kugira umuvuduko wako: ibi bipimo ni rusange kandi bishobora gutandukana ku mugore ku wundi.
PregnancyWeekly.16: Trimestre ya mbere ishyiraho urufatiro: ibice by’ingenzi by’umwana byose bigenda bikorwa buhoro buhoro. Ni n’igihe cyo kunanirwa no kugira iseseme bisanzwe, mu rugero rutandukanye cyane bitewe n’umugore.
PregnancyWeekly.18: Ibi bimenyetso, nubwo rimwe na rimwe bitorohera, ni ikimenyetso ko umubiri urimo kumenyera gutwita ku buryo bukora.
PregnancyWeekly.19: Trimestre ya kabiri akenshi ni yo yoroheje cyane, ubwo ingendo za mbere z’umwana zitangira kugaragara.
PregnancyWeekly.21: Zikunze kumvikana hagati y’ibyumweru 18 na 22, bitaragera hakiri kare gato niba atari bwo bwa mbere utwite.
PregnancyWeekly.22: Trimestre ya gatatu itegura umubiri kubyara, ubwiyongere bw’ibiro no kunanirwa bigaragara cyane. Gukanda kwo kwitoza (kwitwa Braxton Hicks) na ko gushobora kugaragara.
PregnancyWeekly.23: Uku gukanda akenshi nta gahunda gafite kandi ntikubabaza cyane; gutandukana n’ugukanda kw’inda yo kubyara.
PregnancyWeekly.28: Iseseme no kunanirwa, cyane cyane muri trimestre ya mbere
PregnancyWeekly.29: Kubabara gato mu nda bifitanye isano no kurambuka kw’imitsi
PregnancyWeekly.30: Guhumeka bigoranye gake mu gihe cyo gutwita cya nyuma
PregnancyWeekly.31: Ingorane zo gusinzira mu mpera za trimestre ya gatatu
PregnancyWeekly.32: Ibimenyetso bimwe bisaba inama za muganga vuba, trimestre iyo ari yo yose:
PregnancyWeekly.36: Kuribwa umutwe bikabije cyangwa ibibazo byo kubona
PregnancyWeekly.39: Buri trimestre izana impinduka zayo: kuzimenya mbere bigufasha kubaho neza buri cyiciro, bitasimbuye gukurikiranwa buri gihe n’umubyaza cyangwa muganga.
PregnancyWeekly.40: Gutwita kwawe, icyumweru ku cyumweru — AWA

RamadanFasting.6: Inama zifatika n’ibyerekezo by’inyigisho byo kubaho ukwezi kwa Ramadan uri mu mihango, wicecekeye mu mutima.
RamadanFasting.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by’idini bigomba kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa ibyemezo by’idini byihariye.
RamadanFasting.10: Gusiba bihagarikwa mu gihe cy’imihango yawe
RamadanFasting.11: Kubaho ubuzima bwo mu mwuka mu bundi buryo
RamadanFasting.14: Mu gihe cy’imihango yawe, gusiba ntibitegetswe: iki gihe gishyira umugore mu mimerere aho ibikorwa byinshi byo gusenga, harimo no gusiba, bihagarikwa by’agateganyo. Uku guhagarikwa kwemerwa nk’impuhwe, ntabwo ari ukubuzwa cyangwa igihano.
RamadanFasting.15: Guhagarika gusiba mu gihe cy’imihango yawe ntibivuze kuva mu migenzo y’idini. Birahagarikwa igihe gito gusa, hanyuma bigasubukurwa nk’uko bisanzwe imihango irangiye, nta gikorwa cy’ukwemera gitakaye. Iminsi itasibwe izishyurwa nyuma (qadaa), hanze ya Ramadan.
RamadanFasting.17: Iri hagarikwa rishobora no kubonwa nk’igihe gitandukanye mu kwezi, aho ubuzima bwo mu mwuka bukomeza kugaragara mu bundi buryo, nta gusiba.
RamadanFasting.19: Iki kibazo ntigikwiye kubaho gifite kwicira urubanza: ni igice cy’ukwezi gusanzwe k’umubiri kandi kibarwa n’umuco w’idini ubwawo.
RamadanFasting.20: Kudasiba ntibivuze gutandukana n’ukwezi kwa Ramadan. Uburyo bwinshi bwo mu mwuka buracyashoboka kandi bukwemerera gukomeza kubaho iki gihe byuzuye.
RamadanFasting.27: Igihe cyo gutekereza ku giti cyawe
RamadanFasting.30: Ibi bikorwa bito, ndetse byoroheje, bigufasha kuguma uhuye neza n’umwuka w’ukwezi, uko waba umeze kose.
RamadanFasting.31: Kwandika iminsi y’imihango yawe mu gihe cya Ramadan byoroshya nyuma kubara iminsi yo kwishyura (qadaa), kandi bikurinda gushingira ku kwibuka ukwezi kurangiye.
RamadanFasting.32: Andika itariki y’buri munsi utasibye uko bigenda
RamadanFasting.33: Koresha kalendari, porogaramu, cyangwa ikayi yabigenewe
RamadanFasting.34: Kora igenzura ryihuse ku musozo w’ukwezi kugira ngo wemeze igiteranyo
RamadanFasting.36: AWA ishobora kugufasha gukurikirana ukwezi kwawe mu gihe cyose cya Ramadan, kugira ngo ubone aya makuru byoroshye nyuma.
RamadanFasting.38: Uburyo nyabwo bwo kwishyura iminsi yasibwe (igihe, ibihe byihariye nko gutwita cyangwa konsa) bushobora gutandukana bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko y’idini. Ku kibazo cyose cyihariye cyangwa kiruhije, igitekerezo cy’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi gikomeza kuba isoko.
RamadanFasting.40: Gusiba bihagarikwa mu gihe cy’imihango yawe ni impuhwe zemewe, ntabwo ari ukureka imigenzo y’idini. Kubaho iki gihe mu bundi buryo, kwandika iminsi yawe, no gusaba ubuyobozi iyo ushidikanya, byose bigufasha kunyura muri Ramadan wicecekeye mu mutima.
RamadanFasting.41: Gusiba mu gihe cya Ramadan — AWA

RegularIrregularCycle.1:
Ukwezi gutunganye cyangwa kudatunganye:
itandukaniro ni irihe?
RegularIrregularCycle.4: Buri kwezi kw’imihango kuratandukanye. Gusobanukirwa icyitwa “gisanzwe” bishobora kugufasha gukurikirana ubuzima bwawe neza no kubona ibishobora kuba bidatunganye.
RegularIrregularCycle.9: Ni ryari ukwiye kujya kwa muganga?
RegularIrregularCycle.11: Ukwezi kubarwa nk’igutunganye iyo uburebure bwako buri hagati y’iminsi 21 na 35, n’itandukaniro riri munsi y’iminsi 7 hagati y’ukwezi n’ukundi.
RegularIrregularCycle.13: Icy’ingenzi ni ukwitegereza uburyo bwawe mu mezi.
RegularIrregularCycle.15: Buri mugore aratandukanye. Icy’ingenzi ni ukumenya uburyo bwawe n’impinduka zabwo zisanzwe.
RegularIrregularCycle.16: Ukwezi kubarwa nk’igudatunganye iyo uburebure bwako buhinduka kenshi cyangwa mu buryo butateganywa (itandukaniro ry’iminsi irenga 7). Bishobora kugaragara nk’ukwezi kugufi cyane, ukwezi kurekire cyane, cyangwa kudahari kwa ovulation.
RegularIrregularCycle.18: Aya matandukaniro ashobora kuba by’agateganyo cyangwa agakomeza mu mezi menshi.
RegularIrregularCycle.20: Kudatunganya by’agateganyo bishobora kuba bisanzwe (umunaniro w’umutima, impinduka z’imisemburo, kunanirwa…). Ariko niba bikomeza, ni ngombwa gushaka impamvu.
RegularIrregularCycle.24: Ibiro biri hasi cyane cyangwa hejuru cyane
RegularIrregularCycle.26: Nta mihango mu gihe kirenga amezi 3 (hanze yo gutwita/konsa)
RegularIrregularCycle.27: Ukwezi kurekire cyane (kurenga iminsi 90) cyangwa kugufi cyane (munsi y’iminsi 21)
RegularIrregularCycle.28: Ububabare bukomeye bugutesha kubaho mu buryo busanzwe
RegularIrregularCycle.29: Kuva amaraso menshi cyane cyangwa adahoraho
RegularIrregularCycle.30: Niba ugerageza gusama kandi ovulation isa nk’itabaho
RegularIrregularCycle.36: Ukwezi gutunganye cyangwa kudatunganye: itandukaniro ni irihe? — AWA

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.1:
Ubuyobozi bwo mu mwuka
nyuma yo gutakaza
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.6: Ibyerekezo bike by’ubuyobozi bwo mu mwuka bigufasha kunyura mu gutakaza ufite ubugwaneza, kwihangana n’impuhwe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho. Ibibazo by’idini byihariye bigomba kugenzurwa n’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa zihariye.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.15: Gutakaza inda bishobora kuba ikigeragezo gikomeye cyane. Agahinda, guceceka, kuyoberwa, cyangwa gukenera kwisubiza inyuma ni ibyiyumviro bisanzwe by’umuntu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.16: Kumva ibi byiyumviro ntibivuze kubura ukwemera. Buri mugore ashobora kunyura mu bubabare bwe ku muvuduko we.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.19: 2. Imimerere ishobora gutandukana bitewe n’uko bimeze
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.20: Nyuma yo gutakaza, amategeko y’idini ashobora gutandukana bitewe n’uko bimeze n’imiterere y’amaraso yavuye.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.21: By’umwihariko, hashobora kuba ngombwa gutandukanya ubwoko bw’amaraso mbere yo kumenya imigenzo y’idini yo gukurikiza.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.27: Ikibazo cyihariye gishobora gusaba igisubizo gitandukanye. Ni byiza gusaba inama umuntu ubifitiye ubushobozi.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Kwihangana (sabr) ntibivuze kutarira cyangwa kutumva ububabare. Bishobora gusa guherekeza urugendo hamwe n’ukwemera n’ibyiringiro.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Ibikorwa bito bishobora gufasha kugarura buhoro buhoro amahoro: gusaba Imana, akanya ka dhikr, gutega amatwi ibyo mu mwuka, cyangwa kuba hari uwo ukunda.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.35: Gukira bifata igihe. Nta muvuduko rusange wo kunyura mu gutakaza.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.37: Nta mpamvu yo gukora byose icyarimwe. Hitamo ibijyanye n’uko wiyumva n’ibyo ukeneye ubu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.38: Fata igihe cyo kunyura mu bubabare bwawe
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Komeza imigenzo mito yo mu mwuka niba ikuzanira ihumure
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Saba inama ku kibazo cyose cyihariye cy’idini
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.42: Saba ubufasha niba agahinda kakubereye ikibazo cyo kwikorera
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.44: Kwiyitaho, gusaba ubufasha no gukomeza ibyiringiro bishobora buhoro buhoro kuyobora inzira igana amahoro.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.45: Ubuyobozi bwo mu mwuka nyuma yo gutakaza — AWA

ReligiousFaq.1:
Ibibazo bibazwa kenshi
kuri fiqh y’abagore
ReligiousFaq.6: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa cyane kuri fiqh y’abagore, bikusanyirijwe hamwe n’ibisubizo bisobanutse.
ReligiousFaq.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby’inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by’idini bigomba kwemezwa n’abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa ibyemezo by’idini byihariye.
ReligiousFaq.14: Ibibazo byinshi ku kwezi, ku isengesho no ku gusiba bivuka buri gihe ku mugore ku wundi. Dore ibisubizo rusange ku bikunze kubazwa cyane; kugira ngo ujye imbere, buri ngingo inasobanurwa neza mu nkuru yayo yihariye.
ReligiousFaq.16: Fiqh y’abagore ihuza amategeko afatika yerekeye cyane cyane imibiri y’abagore n’uburyo bwo gusenga: ukwezi, isuku, isengesho, gusiba, nifas na istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.17: Ni izihe ngingo z’ingenzi zikubiye muri fiqh y’abagore?
ReligiousFaq.18: Ikubiyemo by’umwihariko imihango n’ukwezi, isuku y’imigenzo, ghusl, isengesho no gusiba mu gihe cy’imihango na nyuma yayo, nifas na istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.19: Itandukaniro riri hagati y’imihango, kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara, no kuva amaraso adahoraho ni irihe?
ReligiousFaq.20: Imihango (hayd) ikurikira ukwezi gusanzwe, nifas iba nyuma yo kubyara, naho istihâda ni ukuva amaraso adahoraho, hanze y’ukwezi. Buri kimwe gikurikiza imimerere itandukanye.
ReligiousFaq.21: Isengesho rigenda rite mu gihe cy’imihango?
ReligiousFaq.22: Isengesho rihagarikwa muri iki gihe: ni ihari ryemewe, ryo kubaho nta kwicira urubanza.
ReligiousFaq.23: Gusiba bigenda bite mu gihe cy’imihango?
ReligiousFaq.24: Gusiba na byo birahagarikwa; iminsi itasibwe yishyurwa nyuma (qadaa), hanze ya Ramadan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Kuki amasengesho yasibwe muri rusange atishyurwa, bitandukanye no gusiba?
ReligiousFaq.26: Iri tandukaniro rituruka ku miterere y’ibikorwa byombi: isengesho ni irya buri munsi kandi risubirwamo, naho gusiba ni umwaka kandi bigashyirwa mu kwezi kumwe. Gukurikiza ihari ni igice cyuzuye cy’imigenzo y’idini.
ReligiousFaq.28: Imihango irangiye kandi ghusl yakozwe, isengesho risubukurwa nk’uko bisanzwe, nta gutinda.
ReligiousFaq.30: Ghusl ni kwiyuhagira kw’ingenzi kwemerera gusubira mu isuku y’imigenzo ikenewe mu gusubukura isengesho n’ibindi bikorwa byo gusenga.
ReligiousFaq.31: Wakora iki niba utazi neza ko imihango yarangiye?
ReligiousFaq.32: Kwitegereza ko nta maraso akiboneka na gato mu gihe gihagije, aho gushingira ku kwiyumvamo kw’akanya, bifasha gusobanura ikibazo.
ReligiousFaq.33: Ese ubundi buryo bwo gusenga bushobora gukorwa mu gihe cy’imihango?
ReligiousFaq.34: Yego: dhikr, gusaba Imana, ubutabazi, kwiga iby’idini n’ibindi bikorwa by’ineza biracyashoboka.
ReligiousFaq.35: Kuki ibisubizo bimwe bishobora gutandukana bitewe n’uko bimeze?
ReligiousFaq.36: Fiqh ni urwego rw’ubusobanuro: ibitekerezo bishobora gutandukana bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko y’idini n’uko umuntu ameze, nta gitekerezo kimwe kiba cyuzuye ku giti cyacyo.
ReligiousFaq.37: Fiqh y’Abayisilamu ikubiyemo amatandukaniro yemewe y’ubusobanuro ku ngingo zimwe z’utuntu. Aya matandukaniro amaze ibinyejana kandi afatwa nk’ayemewe mu muco w’idini.
ReligiousFaq.38: Bitewe n’isoko wagishije inama, ikibazo kimwe gishobora gusubizwa mu buryo butandukanye gato. Ibi ntibivuze ko igisubizo cyaba kibi ako kanya: byerekana uburyo butandukanye n’uko isoko imwe isomwa.
ReligiousFaq.40: Gukurikiza buri gihe isoko ibifitiye ubushobozi, aho guhora uhindura igitekerezo bitewe n’igisubizo cyose ubonye, bifasha gukomeza imigenzo yawe isobanutse kandi ituje.
ReligiousFaq.41: Ibihe bimwe biracyagoye gufatira icyemezo ku busobanuro rusange bumwe. Ibi bigaragara cyane iyo:
ReligiousFaq.42: Hari gushidikanya ku gihe imihango yarangiriye koko
ReligiousFaq.43: Imiterere y’amaraso ikomeza kudasobanuka (imihango, istihâda, ibindi)
ReligiousFaq.44: Gushidikanya gukomeza ku bijyanye no gukenera gukora ghusl
ReligiousFaq.45: Ikibazo cyo gusubukura isengesho gikomeza kudasobanuka
ReligiousFaq.46: Hamenyekanye amakuru atavuga rumwe kuri interineti
ReligiousFaq.48: Iyo ikibazo ari icyihariye, kiruhije cyangwa gikomeza, ntigishobora gukemurwa n’amakuru rusange. Kwegera umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi, ushobora kwita ku kibazo cyawe cyihariye, bikomeza kuba uburyo bwiza muri icyo gihe. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa ibyemezo by’idini byihariye.
ReligiousFaq.49: Fiqh y’abagore ikubiyemo ibice byinshi by’imigenzo y’idini y’abagore
ReligiousFaq.50: Utuntu tumwe dushobora gutandukana mu buryo bwemewe bitewe n’ishuri ry’amategeko y’idini
ReligiousFaq.51: Amakuru rusange ntasimbura ubuyobozi bw’idini bwihariye
ReligiousFaq.52: Gushidikanya gukomeza bikwiye kuganirwaho n’umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi
ReligiousFaq.53: Uruhare rwa AWA ni inyigisho, ntabwo ari ugutanga fatwa
ReligiousFaq.54: Ibibazo bibazwa kenshi kuri fiqh y’abagore — AWA
